inputs.text: Fixed camera, full-body view of the exact same hand-drawn cartoon character. He lowers his raised free hand from his forehead to his chest and makes one short palm-up questioning gesture, keeping that hand close to his body. He keeps holding the same opaque white ceramic mug in his other hand. His head and torso maintain the same three-quarter angle facing right throughout. Preserve the original thick irregular black ink outlines, rough painted shading, muted colors, moustache, facial proportions, dirty vest, gold necklace, trousers and sandals. The original illustrated character comes to life without being redesigned. Static plain gray background. No camera motion.
